title: Quaternionic Sums of Squares, Moments, and Quaternionic Polynomial Optimization
summary: We develop a moment-quaternionic-sum-of-squares (Moment--QSOS) framework for global polynomial optimization over the standard Hamilton quaternions. The main difficulty is the hybrid algebraic structure of scalar quaternionic variables: multiplication is noncommutative, while scalar evaluations satisfy additional polynomial identities inherited from the four commuting real coordinates of each quaternion.
